Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Recap: We covered high-level architecture needs (HIPAA-adjacent workloads, VPC deployment, latency targets ~50ms p50), primary inference patterns (chat + embedding/rerank), and a rough usage profile (~5M tokens/month expected in Year 1).
- Ask: We recommend a 60-minute technical deep-dive that includes an infra walkthrough (networking, VPC/private deployment), an ops run-through for scaling and batching, and a short QA on security controls (SOC2, audit logs).

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wednesday Jul 5 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT

Please confirm which works best and who from your side will join (esp. SRE/networking + compliance). I’ve cc’d Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (solutions engineer) to join the session.

I attached a one-page agenda to help with internal alignment. Once you confirm a slot I’ll send the calendar invite (Google Meet) with the deck/agenda and an .ics for your calendar.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Cheers,
